Premium Multi-Layer Stickers with Texture, Structure, and Adhesion PU Stickers are built for branding that relies on material presence, not surface print. With a leather-like matte finish and a defined multi-layer construction, they introduce depth, softness, and structure in a single application. They don’t just sit on a surface - they become part of it. Surface That Doesn’t Feel Flat PU embossed stickers are designed to create a quiet premium effect:
  • Soft-touch surface with a leather-like feel
  • Matte, non-reflective finish for a clean visual tone
  • Fine grain texture that mimics natural leather
  • A controlled, structured feel - not too rigid, not too flexible
The fine grain texture is a subtle micro-texture across the surface that breaks flatness, diffuses light, and gives the label a more natural, material-like appearance rather than a printed look. Multi-Layer Construction (Engineered Feel) What sets PU embossed label apart is how they are built - not just how they look. Each label consists of a layered structure that creates both texture and durability:
  • Top Layer (PU Surface) A matte, leather-like surface with fine grain texture. This layer defines the tactile experience - soft, slightly textured, and visually refined.
  • Core / Body Layer Provides thickness, structure, and dimensional stability. This layer allows controlled build-up within the label, contributing to its dimensional presence.
  • Adhesive Layer A pressure-sensitive backing that ensures clean, consistent application across surfaces.
Together, these layers create a label that is:
  • Soft to touch yet structurally stable
  • Flexible enough to conform, but not flimsy
  • Visually clean, yet physically dimensional
Convex Raised Effect (Material-Based Elevation) Embossed stickers allow specific areas of the design to be selectively raised above the base surface, creating a soft convex, protruding effect. This is achieved by building up selected areas within the internal structure layer, rather than pressing or stamping the material.
  • The chosen design elements protrude outward from the label surface
  • The PU top layer wraps smoothly over these raised areas
  • The result is a rounded, soft elevation - not sharp or rigid
  • Transitions between raised and flat areas remain clean and seamless
The effect feels:
  • Cushioned when touched
  • Noticeably lifted above the surrounding surface
  • Visually dimensional under light
  • Fully integrated into the material, not applied on top
This creates a refined protruding depth that highlights key elements without relying on gloss or heavy effects. Built for Real-World Use
  • Water-resistant → suitable for everyday handling
  • Scratch-resistant → maintains a clean surface over time
  • Indoor & outdoor compatibility → adaptable across applications

  • Medical or functional applications

Packaging Options
  • Individual pieces → ready for direct use
  • Sheets → optimized for bulk handling
A Different Kind of Branding Surface PU labels don’t rely on gloss, shine, or heavy effects. They rely on layering, texture, and restraint. For brands looking for a softer, more playful dimension, options like Custom Puffy Stickers offer a thicker, cushioned feel, while 3D Epoxy Stickers focus on a high-gloss, domed finish. PU stickers are adhesive-backed, allowing them to function as stickers while maintaining a leather-like appearance. Are embossed labels waterproof? They are water-resistant and suitable for everyday use, including light outdoor exposure. What surfaces can PU embossed stickers be applied to? PU stickers can be applied to a variety of surfaces including packaging materials, plastics, paper-based products, and certain fabrics, depending on the application. Can embossed stickers be customized in shape and size? Yes, PU stickers can be die-cut into any custom shape and produced in a wide range of sizes based on your design requirements. Do PU stickers have a matte or glossy finish? PU embossed stickers feature a matte, leather-like finish with a fine grain texture, giving them a premium and refined appearance. What is the difference between PU stickers, puffy stickers, and 3D epoxy stickers? The difference comes down to material, structure, and surface effect:
  • PU Embossed Stickers Built using a multi-layer construction, PU stickers have a matte, leather-like textured surface with a soft-touch feel. Selected areas can be raised in a convex, protruding form, creating a controlled, material-based depth rather than a glossy or exaggerated 3D effect.
  • Puffy Stickers Made using foam layers, they create a soft, thick, cushion-like 3D feel with more noticeable height and playful dimension.
  • 3D Epoxy Stickers Coated with a clear resin layer, they have a smooth, glossy dome finish that creates a high-shine, glass-like appearance with strong light reflection.
Each option offers a different tactile and visual experience, depending on whether the goal is subtle material depth, soft elevation, or high-gloss impact.

Flat stickers and labels are decals printed on sheets or individually cut—often die-cut for easy peeling. Lightweight and compact, they’re ideal for global shipping, easy storage, and bulk orders.

At PuffSticker.com, we offer extensive customization options for flat sticker labels tailored to your business. Choose from a wide range of sizes, shapes, materials, and finishes to match your branding or personal style. Whether it’s a logo, slogan, image, or custom message, we print it with precision and vibrant color.

Custom Puffy Stickers & 3D Foam Labels – Stand Out with Style

Design vibrant, customizable puffy stickers and 3D foam labels for personal or business use—unique, durable, and always eye-catching.

Custom Promotional Bags – Unique, Eco-Friendly & Brand-Forward

Custom promotional bags printed on eco-friendly materials like kraft paper, jute, and nylon. Fully customizable, durable, and ideal for giveaways, events, and marketing. Boost your brand visibility with high-quality prints from PuffSticker.com.

Elevate your brand with premium custom foil stickers that combine high-end aesthetics with innovation, sustainability, and compliance. Designed to trigger emotion and perceived value, our custom stickers offer a multi-dimensional depth that matte finishes can't match. Whether you need the warm elegance of rose gold, the classic shine of gold foil, or the vibrant shift of holographic silver, these tactile assets are engineered to make your brand unforgettable.

Smooth, glossy, and visually sealed, custom epoxy stickers create a polished form of depth that feels precise rather than soft. Their clear resin dome reflects light sharply, giving designs a more refined and permanent appearance. Often used for product badges, branding, packaging, and premium applications, epoxy stickers stand apart through clarity, smoothness, and controlled surface reflection.
